_doc: Redacted wg-quick profiles for the Cloud SuperApp full-config artifact. SECURITY: the PrivateKey VALUE is stripped here at the source boundary, so this PUBLIC repo can never carry it. Source of truth for the real keys stays cloud-vault (PRIVATE) A0_keys/providers/wireguard/termux-public/config-<profile>; the device holds its own key and imports it from file. Verified 2026-08-31: none of the four configs contains a PresharedKey, so PrivateKey is the only secret line.

v4-full.name: wg-v4-full
v4-full.config_text:
# wg-v4-full — IPv4 wifi, FULL tunnel (v4 via gcp-proxy, v6 via oci-analytics)
# Identity: termux (10.0.0.9 + fd0c:1d00::9 wg0 / 10.1.0.9 + fd0c:1d01::9 wg-public)
# DNS is MESH-ONLY (hickory 10.0.0.1 via gcp-proxy, unbound-DNS64 10.1.0.1 /
# fd0c:1d01::1 via oci-analytics) — two resolvers over two hubs = in-mesh
# redundancy, no external resolver ever.

[Interface]
PrivateKey = <PROVIDED_BY_DEVICE>
Address = 10.0.0.9/24, 10.1.0.9/24, fd0c:1d00::9/64, fd0c:1d01::9/64
MTU = 1380
DNS = 10.0.0.1, 10.1.0.1

[Peer]
# gcp-proxy — all IPv4 internet (gcp-proxy has no v6 egress) + wg0 mesh v6.
# fd0c:1d00::/64 MUST be listed here even though v6 egress goes to
# oci-analytics: it is more specific than the other peer's ::/0, so mesh v6
# reaches the hub directly instead of being handed to oci-analytics (which
# drops it — termux's allowed source there is fd0c:1d01::9, not fd0c:1d00::9).
PublicKey = vV/phXUwnCjxACQ5Df11Uw47BzJaK4r85jPYMu2HmDc=
Endpoint = 35.226.147.64:443
AllowedIPs = 0.0.0.0/0, fd0c:1d00::/64
PersistentKeepalive = 25

[Peer]
# oci-analytics — wg-public mesh + ALL IPv6 (it has v6 egress + NAT64)
PublicKey = Bnyf83VpvGY4BjcjQEXgutNEzx9OXMltHIcKNh7cKkc=
Endpoint = 129.151.228.66:51821
AllowedIPs = 10.1.0.0/24, fd0c:1d01::/64, ::/0
PersistentKeepalive = 25

[Interface]

[Peer]
# gcp-proxy — wg0 hub (udp/443 REDIRECT->51820 survives port filtering)

[Peer]
# oci-analytics — wg-public hub (+NAT64 prefix so DNS64 answers route in-mesh)
PublicKey = Bnyf83VpvGY4BjcjQEXgutNEzx9OXMltHIcKNh7cKkc=
Endpoint = 129.151.228.66:51821
AllowedIPs = 10.1.0.0/24, fd0c:1d01::/64, 2603:c026:c104:8f00:ff9b::/96
PersistentKeepalive = 25
